function: Position-based downlink precoder generation: NN maps UE position and uplink reference CFRs of fixed wireless nodes (environment sensing) to the per-subcarrier precoder, without CSI feedback (pp. 4-5).
system: FDD massive MIMO-OFDM downlink, BS 64 antennas (ULA), UE and fixed wireless nodes 4 antennas, 256 subcarriers, 50 MHz, 3.5 GHz, DeepMIMO outdoor urban; no RIS (pp. 8-9).
method: PS-Net: CNN and self-attention feature extractor, weight-generation module, adaptive sinc position encoder, FC mapper; unsupervised training on negative spectral efficiency; random phase-shift augmentation (pp. 5-8).
data_channel: DeepMIMO ray-tracing dynamic outdoor urban scenario with moving vehicles (BS 1, user grid 1); 110 time points, 740 UE positions each, plus CFRs of 3 fixed wireless nodes (p. 8).
test_conditions: Trained on 670 UEs at 90 time points; tested on 70 other UEs at 20 other time points (new scatterer layouts), same DeepMIMO scenario; 3 FWNs (pp. 8-9).
baselines: Non-learned: Position-AoA [21], perfect-CSI SVD upper bound. Learned: Position-FC [26] (also with fine-tuning), Feedback-CsiNet [11], CRNet [16], TransNet [17] with SVD precoding (pp. 9-11).
metrics: Spectral efficiency (bits/s/Hz) versus transmit power, feedback bits, number of FWNs and training time points; performance loss relative to perfect CSI for LoS and NLoS (pp. 10-11).
openness: none released; uses the public DeepMIMO generator (p. 8).
q1_support: p. 8: "an open source wireless channel generator DeepMIMO [46] is adopted to produce the dataset, which is used for training and evaluation of the proposed method and various benchmarks".
q2_support: p. 9: "the training set contains the data of 670 UEs in 90 time points, and the testing set consists of the data of the remaining 70 UEs in 20 different time points". Disjoint split of the same DeepMIMO scenario (same BS, band, antennas); no other scenario, site, band or antenna count is tested.
q3_support: p. 9: "the BS uses the positions of UE and itself to calculate the AoA of the LoS path by geometric derivation" (non-learned); p. 9: "Position-FC [26]: This is a deep learning-enabled approach"; p. 10: "achieving remarkable performance gain compared with the Position-FC method" (spectral efficiency).
q4_support: p. 2: "A low-complexity position-based precoding framework is proposed" is the only statement; no operation count, parameter count or runtime is given. Overhead in feedback bits and pilots (Table I, p. 3; Fig. 12, p. 10) is signaling, not computation.
q5_support: p. 8: "an open source wireless channel generator DeepMIMO [46] is adopted to produce the dataset, which is used for training and evaluation of the proposed method and various benchmarks". Public DeepMIMO data are used; the paper gives no link to its own code.
notes: Title and DOI match on p. 1. Area 3: PS-Net outputs the downlink precoder; the sensing is environment perception from uplink CSI of fixed wireless nodes and the precoder serves communication only, so not area 5; reviewer to confirm. q2 borderline: the test set is 70 unseen UEs at 20 unseen time points (different scatterer layouts, p. 8) of the same DeepMIMO scenario, treated as held-out data of the same scenario. q4: the claim of low complexity is only qualitative.
